author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: The 21 February recognition of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions hit European, Hong Kong and crypto tapes while US cash markets still showed 18 February closes after Presidents' Day, so the edition leans Bearish on US/EU/PL equities, favours energy, staples and gold, and treats Fed hike size (25 vs 50 bps) as the second driver through a bear-flattening curve.
sources_policy: Only the 2022-02-22 frozen feed, own-date card and exclusions; company results within 14 days, news/previews within 7, macro within 35; US card values tagged 18 February closes, European/Asian 21 February; sanctions, Nord Stream 2 and Home Depot results treated only as pending; no numeric spot-FX.
known_ambiguities_omitted: Day-granular 21 February 08:00 stamps on Putin/Atlantic Council items may describe evening events; used only as the known recognition and troop order, no invasion as fact
Truth Social launch used as 21 February fact via own-date headlines only
No first-tranche sanctions, Nord Stream 2 certification halt or Home Depot outcome
